children: Japan's factory output rose 0.1% in July from the previous month, versus the median market forecast for a 0.7% dip, government data showed on Monday.
Manufacturers surveyed by the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry expect seasonally adjusted output to increase 6.4% in August and fall 4.2% in September.
